newsitem.title: INDIA: India's 1995/96 BoP deficit at $1.21 billion-RBI.
newsitem.headline: India's 1995/96 BoP deficit at $1.21 billion-RBI.

text.p: India's 1995/96 (April-March) balance of payments deficit was $1.21 billion against a surplus of $6.10 billion the previous year, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said in its annual report for 1995/96 (July-June).
A slowdown in external capital inflows was the principal reason for the deterioration in the balance of payments, the report, released on Friday, said.
Net capital flows declined sharply in 1995/96 and fell short of the current financing requirement, the report said.

"The ebbing of capital flows reflected the reduced dependence on the medium and long-term debt-creating flows such as external assistance and external commercial borrowings, which together accounted for barely a sixth of the financing requirements."
The report said net external assistance fell to $780 million in 1995/96 from $1.43 billion the previous year while net commercial borrowings fell to $527 million from $1.03 billion.
Net foreign investments fell to $4.22 billion from $4.89 billion, RBI said.
